summary: Lookup collision material properties from global lookup tables keyed by material index a1. Basic materials (index 0..7) take the dword_7CA388 / unk_7CA3A4 path; extended materials (index >7) take the flt_7CA3C0 negative-index path with negated flt_7CA36C values. Returns the a3 output pointer.

operations.description: Branch on material index a1: values greater than 7 take the extended-material path; values 0..7 take the basic-material path.
Extended path: store flt_7CA3C0[-a1] (negative index into the extended material table) into *a2.
Extended path: store the negation of flt_7CA36C[a1] into *a3.
Basic path: store dword_7CA388[a1] into *a2, written as a dword.
Basic path: store the value read backwards from the unk_7CA3A4 table by index a1 into *a3.
Return the a3 output pointer in eax.

unresolved: Semantic role of the two output values (a2 and a3) is not independently confirmed; the existing analysis labels them friction and restitution but the raw source carries no naming.
Whether the a1 index space represents a material ID enum or a bitmask is unverified.
